# Russian Wikipedia (Википедия)

> Free multilingual online encyclopedia powered by MediaWiki, offering comprehensive coverage of history, science, culture, and knowledge in Russian and other languages.

Russian Wikipedia is a major collaborative encyclopedia project maintained by the Wikimedia Foundation. It serves as a primary reference resource for Russian-speaking users worldwide, containing articles on diverse topics from Soviet history and economics to natural sciences and cultural heritage.

## Key Topics

- Wikipedia
- Free Content
- MediaWiki
- Russian Language
- Soviet History
- Article Review
- Content Moderation
- Editing Guidelines
- Quality Standards
- Numismatics
- Gold and Precious Metals
- Russian SFSR
- Encyclopedia
- Wikimedia Foundation
- Vandalism Prevention
